sources.title: CIME coupler budget diagnostics
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: MITgcm：封閉水盒熱量與溫度增量驗證
related.titleEn: MITgcm: closed-water-box heat and temperature increments
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：零殘差要求只適用本例完整收支，不盲目消除真實儲能。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The zero-residual requirement applies to this complete fixture budget, not to unmodeled physical storage.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「MITgcm：封閉水盒熱量與溫度增量驗證」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付熱容量推導、兩時間窗能量表、符號控制組與模型邊界說明。
related.differenceEn: Investigate MITgcm: closed-water-box heat and temperature increments using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver thermal-capacity derivation, energy tables for both intervals, sign-control cases and a model-boundary statement identifying the neglected transport and geometry effects.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐面計算二乘十及三乘二十，再相加；用五平方米與正確加權平均十六交叉核對。
將熱通量乘面積得到 2000 W，再乘六十秒；逐步寫單位以排除 W 與 J 混用。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute each face contribution and sum them. Cross-check using total area five and weighted mean flux sixteen, distinguishing the weighted mean from the unweighted mean of the two input values.

Multiply flux density by area to obtain 2000 watts, then integrate for sixty seconds. Carry units through both operations and explain why a power value alone cannot determine a temperature increment without duration.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SLEPc：特徵對殘差與後向誤差資格
related.titleEn: SLEPc: eigenpair residuals and backward-error qualification
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：零殘差要求只適用本例完整收支，不盲目消除真實儲能。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The zero-residual requirement applies to this complete fixture budget, not to unmodeled physical storage.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「SLEPc：特徵對殘差與後向誤差資格」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付矩陣向量乘法帳本、殘差向量、規範化檢查與特徵對驗收表。
related.differenceEn: Investigate SLEPc: eigenpair residuals and backward-error qualification using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver matrix-vector arithmetic, residual vectors, normalization checks and an eigenpair acceptance table distinguishing backward error from spectral conditioning and forward error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐面計算二乘十及三乘二十，再相加；用五平方米與正確加權平均十六交叉核對。
計算 Ax=[1.2,4] 與 λx=[2.4,3.2]，再由差向量求規範化誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute each face contribution and sum them. Cross-check using total area five and weighted mean flux sixteen, distinguishing the weighted mean from the unweighted mean of the two input values.

Compute Ax=[1.2,4] and lambda*x=[2.4,3.2], then form the difference. Retain both components rather than reducing early to a scalar, allowing a reviewer to identify which direction dominates the defect.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
